ORDER The writ petition came up for consideration on 07.08.2024, wherein, we had reduced the facts as follows :

The petitioner has been filed the writ petition seeking a direction to grant Emergency Leave for a period of fifteen days without escort to her husband,
A.K.Subbu @ Subramanian, who is now lodged at Central Prison, Tiruchirappalli,
consequent to be convicted for offences under Section 120 (b), 471, 420 read with 511 IPC and also under Section 182 IPC, by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Trichy in C.C.No.1 of 2016, by judgment dated 30.01.2020.
He had been convicted to undergo Rigorous Imprisonment for a period of five years.

Another FIR had been registered https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis against the petitioner in C.C.No.9 of 2007 by judgment dated 31.12.2013, the petitioner had also been convicted for various offences for a period of two years of Rigorous Imprisonment.
2. It is contended by the petitioner that her husband is suffering from diabetes and is also suffering from varicose veins necessitating constant treatment to be given.
In fact, his movements are also restricted.
3. Considering his condition, earlier by order dated 19.06.2024, six days leave was granted and it was also extended for a further period of three days.

The leave was from 22.06.2024 till 01.07.2024.
2.

Taking into consideration of the medical condition of the husband of the petitioner, we have called for a report from the Dean, Government Medical College Hospital at Trichy and also whether the said hospital will have necessary facilities to treat the husband of the petitioner.

3. A report, dated 09.08.2024 issued by the Assistant Professor of Department of General Surgery at Umagandhi vs The Superintendent Of Prisons on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189961940/

sentences.text: Trichy Government Hospital has been placed before us, wherein, it has been affirmed that the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis husband of the petitioner suffers from varicose veins and they had obtained opinion of the Vascular Surgeon and Plastic Surgeon.
There is perspiration which is revealed.
It is evident that the husband of the petitioner requires further treatment.

4. Taking into consideration the medical condition of the husband of the petitioner, we would grant 15 days ordinary leave without escort to the husband of the petitioner, A.K.Subbu @
K.Subramanian, who is now confined at Central Prison, Trichy, with permission to take treatment either at Trichy or at any other hospital, but to inform the jurisdictional Police i.e.,
Edamalaipattipudur Police Station at Trichy District, about the movements of the husband of the petitioner.
5.

Accordingly, this writ petition is allowed and the convict prisoner is granted emergency leave for 15 days without escort on the following conditions:-
(a)The detenu, A.K.Subbu @ K.Subramanian, S/o.Krishnasamy, [Convict No.23386],
now detained in the Central Prison, Trichy, is granted ordinary leave for https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis fifteen (15) days from 19.08.2024 to 02.09.2024.
(b)The detenu shall be released from the prison at 10.00 a.m., on 19.08.2024 and he shall return back to the prison at 7.00 p.m., on 02.09.2024.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
